interface.name: bwm_plasma_desktop_control_v1

description.summary: Per-connection activation barrier for the experimental BWM host

interface.description: Applies only to native desktop activation requests from this same Wayland client. Read events continue. All connections start paused; activation requires a bound control and an explicit resume. Pause discards queued activations of this connection; acknowledged means no such activation can run after the acknowledgement until resumed. Other clients are unaffected. Destroying the control leaves this connection paused until explicitly rebound/resumed or disconnected. No configuration or global mode is changed. When the provider withdraws its globals, existing control resources remain valid but inert until destroyed by the client or disconnected. In-flight requests to retired controls perform no work and produce no acknowledgement.

entry.name: invalid_state
entry.summary: Paused must be zero or one

event.name: desktop_global

description.summary: Registry name of this provider's desktop management global

event.description: Identifies the KDE desktop management global on this same connection. Clients must check registry uniqueness and this association before resume. Zero means that no corresponding global is visible to this client.
